reason: 4,080 EUR in the first year is more than a tenth of what my whole firm bills, and most of that money goes into a website I don't believe brings me clients — all of mine come from people I've already helped. The part I actually want, the document link with reminders, is bolted onto the part I don't.
objection: I'm being asked to pay for 6-8 pages of website and a 12-month subscription to get the one thing that would have saved me today's 120 km drive; plus the person behind it does this on evenings and weekends, and when a farmer's upload breaks the day before a deadline, 'within one working day' is too late.
would_change_my_mind: Sell me the document-collection and reminder automation on its own, for a few hundred euro and a small monthly fee, with no website and no 12-month lock-in; if it saves me two drives a month I'd pay for it gladly.
